title: Petition of Marathon Lines, Inc. for a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity under the provisions of Massachusetts General Laws, Chapter 159A, Section 7 for the operation of vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire over certain public ways in the Cities of Boston, Newton and Worcester and the Towns of Ashland, Brookline, Framingham, Natick, Northborough, Shrewsbury, Southborough, Wellesley, Westborough and Weston and public ways under the jurisdiction of the Massachusetts Turnpike Authority.
